meta.title: Contribute to PISAStyle
meta.description: Propose a correction or a new PISA item. No sign-up, no cookies, no personal data: it opens a GitHub issue with your proposal.

hero.title: Contribute
hero.lead: PISAStyle is open: any visitor can propose a correction or a new item. There is no sign-up, no cookies, and no data is collected. On submit, a GitHub issue opens with what you wrote, and you decide whether to publish it.
hero.privacyBadge: No login · No cookies · No tracking
hero.privacyNote: The draft is saved only in your browser so you do not lose what you wrote. It holds no identifiers and is sent to no server until you press submit.

flow.title: How it works

steps.title: You write the proposal
steps.body: Stem, options, explanation, and the 8 fields of the PISAStyle v1.1 protocol.

steps.title: An issue opens
steps.body: GitHub with the title and body already written. Review and edit anything before publishing.

steps.title: Review and PR
steps.body: The team validates it against the protocol, opens a pull request, and merges it.

flow.note: If the link does not work on your network, download the .md and paste the content into an issue by hand. There is no dead end.

form.typeLegend: What do you want to propose?
form.typeCorrectionHelp: Something already published that is wrong or can be improved.
form.typeNewHelp: A complete item you want to enter into the bank.
form.unitHint: The identifier of the unit where the item lives, for example u-math-04.
form.stemHint: The exact text the student would see.
form.stemPlaceholder: If 3 panels cover 12 m, how many metres do 8 panels cover?
form.optionsHelp: Fill in at least two if the format is multiple choice. Leave empty for a constructed item (open response).
form.explanationHint: Why that is the answer. It is what makes the proposal reviewable.
form.explanationPlaceholder: It is a direct proportion: 12/3 = 4 m per panel, 8 × 4 = 32 m.
form.noteHint: Source, extra justification, or a notice that the item is yours and not in an official framework.
form.notePlaceholder: Source: adapted from a Khan Academy exercise.
form.protocolHelp: The 8 mandatory fields. Without full tagging the item does not enter the bank.

domain.label: Domain
domain.hint: Mathematics, Reading, Science, or Learning in the Digital World (LDW).

process.label: Process
process.hint: The competence or key competence being assessed.

content.label: Content
content.hint: Content block of the PISA framework.

context.label: Context
context.hint: Personal, occupational, societal, scientific, public, educational.

demand.label: Cognitive demand
demand.hint: low, med or high (Bloom × Webb). Not the same as difficulty.

anchor.label: Anchor
anchor.hint: Released OECD item or calibration reference.

messages.optionsMin: Fill in at least two options.
messages.optionsUnexpected: This format takes no options. Remove them or change the format to a multiple choice one.
messages.errorSummaryBody: Fix these fields and submit again:
messages.draftRestored: We recovered the draft saved in this browser.
messages.tooLong: The proposal is too long for a link, so the .md file is the main path. Open the issue and paste it.
messages.urlTooLong: The proposal is too long to open in a link. Download the .md and paste it into a new issue.
messages.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
